title: Giấc mơ tối
about: Round x3 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked for many more versions ("tôi rất thích các phiên bản bạn tạo, hãy tạo thêm cho tôi nhiều phiên bản khác"): a dark dream, with a tune: the glass sings a slow melody, the choir and the pad under it, soft high glass around it; B flat minor at 54 bpm, its G flat and D flat chords warming it a little. An original piece.
